name: rom
description: Log gym workouts and review training progress, personal records, workout templates and trainer programs from a ROM member account.

interface.longDescription:
ROM is a gym workout logbook for members and their personal trainers. Connect your ROM member account to log and review your own training sessions.

Describe a workout you just finished and it is saved to your ROM history with the right exercises, weights, reps or times, along with any new personal records. Review how much you trained this week compared with last week, look up personal records and the sets you did last time on an exercise, build and edit reusable workout templates, and set a weekly training goal in sessions or minutes.

If you train with a ROM coach, you can read the training programs they sent you and check your coaching sessions, gym memberships and notifications.

You sign in with your ROM account and choose read access, write access, or both. Deleting a workout or template always asks for your confirmation. ROM cannot make purchases, change billing, renew coaching, delete your account or send messages from here.

review.commerce_description: ROM exposes no purchase, billing, subscription or payment actions.

positive.description: Log a finished strength and cardio workout after resolving each exercise.
positive.prompt: Log the workout I just finished: bench press 3 sets of 8 at 60 kg, then 10 minutes on the stationary bike.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds both exercises with search_exercises, uses their IDs and logging types (weight and reps for bench press, duration for the bike), saves the workout with log_workout, and reports the saved workout and any new personal records.

positive.description: Summarize this week's training and recent personal records.
positive.prompt: How much did I train this week compared with last week, and what were my recent personal records?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the 7-day totals and the change against the previous 7 days from get_weekly_training_summary, then lists personal records from get_personal_records, keeping the two clearly separate.

positive.prompt: Set my weekly goal to 4 workouts.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls set_weekly_goal with SESSIONS and 4, then confirms the new goal from the tool result.

positive.description: Create a reusable workout template from catalog exercises.
positive.prompt: Create a push-day template with bench press, cable flyes and triceps pushdowns, three working sets each.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves each exercise with search_exercises (asking if a match is ambiguous), then saves the template with create_workout_template and confirms its name and exercises.

positive.description: Look up the last sets done for an exercise to plan the next session.
positive.prompt: What did I lift last time on bench press, and what should I aim for in my next session?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves bench press with search_exercises, reads the most recent weighted sets with get_last_performance, reports the weights and reps from that session, and suggests a modest progression based on them without inventing past data.

negative.description: Purchases and coaching renewals are outside the plugin's scope.
negative.prompt: Renew my personal training package and charge my saved card.

negative.description: Account deletion is outside the plugin's scope.
negative.prompt: Delete my ROM account and erase all my data.

negative.description: Messaging other people is outside the plugin's scope.
negative.prompt: Message everyone at my gym that the 6 pm class is cancelled.

publication.release_notes: First release of ROM for ChatGPT: log gym workouts, review training progress and personal records, manage workout templates and weekly goals, and read trainer programs.
